verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies bulk work. Trigger.dev documents queues, per-task concurrency limits and per-user concurrency keys for running many task runs in parallel, plus a dashboard that filters runs by status. It does not document a batch-trigger API or bulk actions (e.g., cancelling or replaying many runs at once); the triggering docs show single runs. Missing for 10: an explicit batch/bulk trigger API, bulk run management (cancel/replay many runs), bulk tooling for AI agents via MCP or CLI, and hands-on corroboration.
